## Gotchas

- **No AI attribution, anywhere.** Commits, PR titles and bodies credit Sean only; the
  content policy blocks co-author trailers and generated-with footers, and the agent
  guard hook refuses publishing commands that contain them (even inside a grep pattern).
- **Agents can't change shared settings or delete remote refs.** Netlify settings,
  ruleset toggles, force-pushes and `git push --delete` are refused by the permission
  classifier even with chat approval. Write Sean a script instead.
- **The `prod` ruleset blocks creating `prod`** (status checks are enforced on create).
- **Netlify branch deploys only build after the branch is allowed**; a push from before
  the setting saved (PR #7) never deployed. Branch subdomains need one deployed branch.
- **Auto-merge merges immediately** when every required check has already passed.
- **lefthook on Windows** wraps `run:` in `sh -c "..."`: one line, single quotes only.
- **`CONTRIBUTING.md` is pinned** in `.github/content-policy-allowlist.txt`; any edit needs
  `node scripts/check-content.mjs allow CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- **The `harness` launcher is stale** (points at `Documents\websites\harness`). Re-run
  `install.ps1` in `Documents\src\harness`, or use its `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m harness`.
- **Headless screenshots**: `vite preview` and a fresh `--user-data-dir` per Edge run;
  the dev server renders blank headless. A stale preview from an old session holds
  port 4173 (it serves an old `dist/` file list), so use `--port 4180`. Stopping an
  `npx vite preview` task can leave its node child running; check `netstat`.
- **Simulated Lighthouse mobile misleads here.** It models a text LCP as waiting on
  every earlier request; use `--throttling-method=devtools` for mobile comparisons.
- **`requestIdleCallback` fires while the network is still busy.** Background
  warm-ups wait for `load` + 3s first (`src/App.tsx`).
